Description: Internal oscillator not feasible with available SCL 1.2µm PDK SPICE models — analog zip not yet inspected
Mitigation: Extract and inspect Open_Source_SCL_1.2micron_PDK.zip; verify NMOS/PMOS/R/C SPICE model availability; simulate candidate topology with Ngspice
Required Evidence: SPICE simulation with startup + steady-state + PVT corners; confirmed model files in analog PDK

Description: PVT frequency variation of ring oscillator — untuned ring oscillators exhibit ±30–50% frequency variation across process/voltage/temperature corners
Mitigation: Prefer RC oscillator if passives available; trim capability or digital trim register if frequency accuracy matters; document acceptable tone frequency error for toy product
Required Evidence: SPICE corner simulations (SS/FF/TT at 0°C / 27°C / 85°C and VDD ±10%)

Description: POR circuit does not reliably initialise flip-flops to known state — standard-cell FFs have no guaranteed power-up state in most CMOS processes
Mitigation: Design explicit transistor-level POR with RC ramp detector; verify reset pulse width exceeds flip-flop setup+hold requirements across all PVT corners
Required Evidence: SPICE simulation of POR across supply ramp rates 0.1 ms to 100 ms; measured reset pulse width

Description: Mechanical button bounce causes multiple state transitions — current RTL debounce period is 1 ms which is below standard bounce time of 5–20 ms
Mitigation: Increase DEBOUNCE_CYCLES to 10000 (10 ms at 1 MHz); confirm with oscilloscope measurement on actual button sample
Required Evidence: Oscilloscope capture of button bounce; RTL simulation with bounce model

Description: SOUND_OUT pad drive capability insufficient for direct buzzer drive — piezo or magnetic speaker may require more current than a standard logic output pad can provide
Mitigation: Inspect scl1u_pads_typ.lib for maximum DC output current; add external NPN transistor driver on PCB if required; never assume pad can drive speaker directly
Required Evidence: Liberty file pad I/O current specification; PCB validation with actual buzzer load

Description: PDK physical views (GDS macro cells) incompatible with OpenLane/OpenROAD — core_c1d.gds and io_c1d.gds present but compatibility with OpenLane 1.0.x has not been confirmed
Mitigation: Follow eChipHub readme_for_digital step-by-step; run floorplan and placement on a minimal test design first; confirm LEF macro dimensions match GDS
Required Evidence: Successful floorplan of test design; no LVS mismatch between GDS and CDL reference

Description: Standard-cell Liberty library corner mismatch — c1d_core_max/min.lib corner names may not match OpenSTA/OpenROAD expected naming conventions
Mitigation: Inspect Liberty file operating_conditions block; configure OpenSTA timing constraints to reference correct corners by name
Required Evidence: Successful OpenSTA run with all three corners; no "corner not found" errors

Description: KLayout DRC deck (c1d_drc.drc / drc.lydrc) may flag violations on pad-frame GDS structures that are pre-approved waivers — no waiver documentation yet available
Mitigation: Run DRC on the reference frame GDS first; document any clean-pass DRC result; compare user GDS result against reference
Required Evidence: Clean DRC on frame1mmx1mm.gds reference; waiver list for any remaining violations

Description: OpenRCX parasitic extraction may produce pessimistic or inaccurate results if scl_c1d.rcx.lib model was not calibrated against silicon measurements
Mitigation: Use post-layout STA results for sign-off timing only; validate extracted RC values against hand calculations for representative nets
Required Evidence: Extracted SPEF file; STA timing summary with extracted parasitics

Description: COB packaging bond-pad pitch constraint — pad-ring and bond-pad pitch must be compatible with COB wire-bonding equipment; minimum pitch not yet confirmed
Mitigation: Inspect Standard_Pad_Frame_C1D.pdf for pad pitch specification; confirm with manufacturing partner (OS0011 example GDS available)
Required Evidence: COB pad pitch specification from manufacturing datasheet; confirmed match with PadFrame design rules

Description: Die area exceeds minimum COB frame size — digital logic area unknown until synthesis + place-and-route; pad-ring overhead at 1 mm × 1 mm may dominate
Mitigation: Run synthesis with stat command (Yosys) to estimate gate count; use rule-of-thumb 10× area margin for place-and-route; select smallest available frame size (1 mm × 1 mm available)
Required Evidence: Synthesis area report from Yosys stat; P&R area report from OpenROAD

Description: WSL2 not installed — Linux EDA tools (iverilog/Yosys/OpenROAD/KLayout) cannot run on Windows natively with sufficient compatibility
Mitigation: Install WSL2 (Ubuntu 22.04 LTS) as prescribed by eChipHub guide; install tools in WSL2; keep project files on Windows filesystem accessible via /mnt/c
Required Evidence: Successful WSL2 installation; successful iverilog simulation of RTL; successful Yosys synthesis run

Description: Analog PDK SPICE models not yet extracted — 18.8 MB zip file present but not opened; NMOS/PMOS model corners and passive component models unknown
Mitigation: Extract Open_Source_SCL_1.2micron_PDK.zip; locate .spi/.sp/.model files; verify against Reference Document for SCL Analog PDK
Required Evidence: Identified SPICE model files with NMOS/PMOS level parameters and corners; passive component model availability confirmed

Description: Functional specification ambiguity — approved specification requires continuous tone per state; existing RTL implements one-shot melody sequences; these are architecturally incompatible
Mitigation: Owner must confirm which behaviour is required (ADL-017); RTL to be rewritten or confirmed accordingly before synthesis proceeds
Required Evidence: Written owner decision recorded in ADL-017

Description: Power budget unknown — no supply current measurement is possible until oscillator and digital logic are both characterised; toy application typically limited to coin cell (100–200 mA peak is too high)
Mitigation: Estimate dynamic power from Yosys stat (gate count × activity × cap × VDD²× f); estimate oscillator quiescent current from SPICE simulation; compare against target (< 5 mA average for battery toy)
Required Evidence: Yosys area/power report; SPICE current waveform from oscillator simulation

Description: Post-synthesis netlist uses SystemVerilog constructs (always_ff / always_comb / unique case) — iverilog -gspecify mode may not support all SV features without -g2012 flag
Mitigation: Test iverilog simulation with -g2012 flag; consider converting to plain Verilog if SV support is incomplete in older iverilog version
Required Evidence: Successful iverilog compilation of all RTL modules; no syntax errors

Description: No external reset pin — if POR fails or brownout is not handled the controller may enter an unknown state with no recovery path except power cycling
Mitigation: Validate POR across full supply ramp profile; consider adding optional external reset pin if POR validation shows marginal behaviour
Required Evidence: SPICE POR validation across all ramp conditions; decision on whether test/reset pin is added
